---
name: Show us your use
about: You put Oathline between an agent and something real. Tell us what it governs and what it refused.
labels: use-case

<!-- A security problem is never a public issue. Report it privately as SECURITY.md says. -->

**What the agent can change through Oathline** (email, a database, payments, files, a phone call...)

**How the person sees the action before saying yes** (a card, a screen, a spoken read-back; which `channel`)

**One refusal Oathline made that you were glad of** (the code it returned, and what would have happened without it)

**One thing that was awkward** (an API shape, a missing refusal, a limit you hit)

**Numbers, if you have them** (events in the chain, `unheard_runs()` count, how long it has been running)

**May we link to this from the README?** yes / no
